description:
MOVEHOME ESTATE AGENTS... are honoured to be the first agent to sell this wonderful old period home since it was originally constructed and purchased by the same family 98 years ago. The family have resided in this beautiful 4 bedroom 2 bathroom, mid terraced property all their lives and have finally decided to offer this fantastic home to the open market and give a new family a new opportunity. The house oozes great charm and appeal, spanning 110 m² / 1,184 ft² on two levels and sits with great pride on the south side of the established Home Farm Road. No. 98 requires modernisation throughout, yet is still habitable, as the new owners can reside and decide what way they would like to extend and insulate this dream home.

The property has been well maintained over the past 98 years and includes many original features like wooden flooring (under the current carpets), coving and each of the four fireplaces are original. Upon entering the welcoming entrance hallway with a spacious bathroom and a separate cloak room, each of which are located on each side of the stairs. The hall leads into the spacious front living room with a feature corner fireplace and bright front large window which flood the room with natural light throughout the day. Double sliding doors then lead into the rear living space, which provides ample space for entertainment, with another corner fireplace and overlooks the large rear garden. Just beyond the hallway, which flows out into the small original kitchen, which leads onto the conservatory that offers access to the south facing garden approximately 45ft long.

Upstairs, off the open landing are the 4 spacious bedrooms, 3 of which are well proportioned double bedrooms, two of which have their original fireplaces. A single bedroom is located near the stairs, and a fully tiled family bathroom sits between the rear side of the landing. The attic is an opportunity to convert and can be accessed from the landing. The home benefits from off street parking to the front for two vehicles and is fully paved for vehicles. The property requires modernisation and presents a truly wonderful opportunity for the new purchasers to add their own touch on this promising forever home, which it was for the current family who now finally moved! 

The location of Number 98 is situated just literally around the corner from Drumcondra village with all local amenities on your doorstep. Third level colleges, Dublin City University and St Patrick's Teacher Training College are within easy walking distance. Trinity College Dublin and University College Dublin are both on direct bus routes. Local national schools include, Corpus Christi National School (3 minutes' walk) Scoil Mobhi, St Patrick's National School and Grace Park Educate Together. Secondary schools are within walking distance are Scoil Caitriona, Holy Faith Secondary Schools, Dominican College, Rosmini and Clonturk along with a variety of local sports clubs including Na Fíanna GAA Club, Clontarf Golf Club and Tolka Park Shelbourne FC. For lazy weekend brunches, lunch and dinner Anderson's Café, Shouk Restaurant are only a few minute stroll away.

The Botanic Gardens and Griffith Park, which are beautiful green areas are within the immediate vicinity and just a short stroll away. Dublin City University is within reach, alongside many sports clubs. The M50, Dublin Airport and M1 are a couple minutes drive from the home. Dublin City Centre can be easily reached by a 10 minute drive or the many bus routes nearby, one of which is on Home Farm Road. 

Early viewing is essential to appreciate all this wonderful home has to offer and by appointment with MOVEHOME ESTATE AGENTS ... 01-88 44 690
